items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I told you once we backed Billie Holiday down there... I did another song for Billie Holiday just before she died but -- and she liked it

ctx.x: Well, when did you finally get your name on the record?

Oh, well, I missed all of the royalties from the first record because my name wasn't on it then and -- from the first months of that Billie Holiday record. And that was the most lucrative part of it, you know. I got it all later, about a year or so later.
Because I know in her book she says that you each got $75.00.

items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: when Billy ie Holiday was singing with Artie Shaw they wanted her to come in the back door

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. At one time. I mean not that bad but, you know, when Billy ie Holiday was singing with Artie Shaw they wanted her to come in the back door, you know.
Yeah, right. But that was mixing (inaudible).
